note: Kasikornbank's sales sheet for K eSavings (conditions as announced effective 25 April 2026): an account maintenance fee of 20 baht a month falls only on an account inactive for more than a year with under 2,000 baht in it, which an account in use never is; transaction fees across clearing zones aren't modelled. Read again 2026-10-30: K-eSavings pays 1.25% a year on the first 500,000 baht and 0.35% on the excess (the first rate written; the form holds one); it is opened through K PLUS by a Thai national from 12 (nationality is a condition the form doesn't hold). Not stated: overdraft, ATM and transfer fees, abroad.

sources.title: Kasikornbank, Sales Sheet: K eSavings
sources.said: Account maintenance fee Account maintenance fee of 20 Baht/month will be charged if account is inactive for more than one year and the account balance is less than 2,000 Baht.

sources.title: Kasikornbank, Sales sheet, K-eSavings: rate and conditions
sources.said: - Deposit up to 500,000 Baht : 1.25% ... - Deposit in excess of 500,000 Baht : 0.35% ... - Depositor must be a natural person of Thai nationality, not less than 12 years old.
